dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, durian ice cream! What's it like?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈdʊriən ˈaɪs ˌkriːm! ˈwʌts ɪt ˈlaɪk?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I think it's delicious. And sweet.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈθɪŋk ɪts dɪˈlɪʃəs. ənd ˈswiːt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I think so. Maybe a little!
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈθɪŋk ˈsoʊ. ˈmeɪbi ə ˈlɪtəl!
